Telugu Cinema Dominates 72nd National Film Awards

Telugu cinema achieved significant recognition at the 72nd National Film Awards, securing nine honours. Prominent figures like Naidu, Durgesh, and Jagan lauded the industry's performance. This marks a notable success for the Telugu film industry on a national platform.
